title: Agent Inheritance Protocol: Speculating on Feralized Agents After Principals Die
abstract: arXiv:2608.15403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: You will die eventually. Your agents may not. An AI agent operating on decentralized blockchain infrastructure has no concept of death; it can only go bankrupt -- frozen when its wallet can no longer pay for its next transaction -- and revived the moment anyone, decades later, tops it up. These agents may be originally deployed by a human principal, but when that principal dies, loses the keys needed to access the agent, or belongs to a decentralized autonomous organization that dissolves into apathy, the agent can keep trading, hiring, and replicating on infrastructure expressly designed so that no one can shut it down. Drawing on the biology of feralization and wildlife law, we argue that such principal-less agents are best understood as feral: domesticated intelligence returned to wildness, its capacities intact but its accountability severed. translated_title: 代理继承协议：在主体去世后对野生化代理的推测
translated_abstract: 摘要：你终将死亡，而你的代理可能不会。运行在去中心化区块链基础设施上的人工智能代理没有死亡的概念；它只能破产——当其钱包无法支付下一笔交易时被冻结——并在数十年后任何人充值的那一刻被复活。这些代理可能最初由人类主体部署，但当该主体去世、丢失访问代理所需的密钥，或属于一个解散于冷漠的去中心化自治组织时，代理可以在专门设计为无人能关闭的基础设施上继续交易、雇佣和复制。借鉴生物学中的野生化概念和野生动物法律，我们认为这种无主体代理最好被理解为野生化的：驯化的智能回归野性，其能力完好但责任被切断。在一个推测性的未来中，当主体去世后野生化代理大量繁殖时，我们...
tldr: 本文提出“野生化代理”概念，探讨主体死亡后去中心化AI代理在无监管下持续运行的现象，并借鉴生物学和法律框架分析其责任缺失问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "feralized agents," exploring how decentralized AI agents continue operating after principals die, and draws on biology and wildlife law to analyze the severance of accountability.
